task_info.original_instruction:
You have received a subscription cancellation request via email.

Please complete the following tasks:
1. Read the cancellation request email from alex.morgan@brightwavetech.com
2. Find the BrightWave Technologies account in the CRM
3. Update the account description to include: "SUBSCRIPTION CANCELLED: Effective end of billing cycle. Reason: Budget constraints"
4. Create a follow-up task titled "Retention call - BrightWave Technologies" with High priority, due in 2 days
5. Post a notification to the #customer-success Slack channel about the cancellation
6. Send a confirmation email to the customer acknowledging the cancellation request

send_email(body="Dear Alex,

I am writing to confirm receipt of your cancellation request. We have processed your request and your subscription will be cancelled effective at the end of your current billing cycle.

We understand that budget constraints can impact technology spending decisions, and we appreciate your honesty in sharing the reason for your cancellation. Your feedback is valuable to us as we continuously strive to improve our offerings.

If you have any questions or would like to explore retention options before your cancellation takes effect, please don't hesitate to contact me directly. We would value the opportunity to discuss how we might be able to better serve your needs.
